non-blocking: a run dispatched as the codex baseline whose launch record carries anchored_edit true is kept in the codex arm, while the same contamination is excluded on the clive side at :387, so the two baselines are held to different rules; no run here trips it (9 codex baseline launches read false, 9 codex-anchored read true), so the figures stand and the rule does not.

non-blocking: arm_membership reads only the server-status conjunct of section 8's Claude rule and never its second, that the run was launched after section 10 landed, so a pre-section-10 run with a connected server would count in the anchored arm; no run is excluded on membership here, so the omission's effect is unmeasured rather than nil.
